## Description

Describe the change and related requirement.

## Files changed

List affected files and coordinate with their owners.

## Tests performed

List commands, observed results, and any checks not completed.

## Related Trello card

Link the card, or explain why there is none.

## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] Changes stay within the agreed scope.
- [ ] File owners reviewed cross-area changes.
- [ ] Shared type or configuration changes were coordinated.
- [ ] TypeScript checks and production build pass.
- [ ] Relevant browser checks were performed.
- [ ] No secrets or real student records were added.
